title: Personal Loans Courtesy Waivers: PracticePay Courtesy Point
content:
## Rule

A PracticePay courtesy point applies to a Personal Loans courtesy waiver: any PracticePay plan of the borrower closed as paid in full (closure reason paid in full, or paid in full within the promotional period) gives 0.1; with no such plan, a PracticePay plan in active status together with no PracticePay late fee charged on any of the borrower's plans fewer than 12 whole calendar months (whole calendar months being the difference in calendar months, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's) before the request date gives 0.05; a borrower with neither gets no point.

The plans are the borrower's PracticePay Patient Financing plans; their status, closure reason and late fees are read from the borrower's PracticePay records.

A point is added to the courtesy share by which the courtesy amount is taken; the courtesy share is held between zero and one.

| Borrower's PracticePay Patient Financing plans | Point |
|---|---|
| any plan paid off with closure reason paid in full or paid in full within the promotional period | 0.10 |
| none such; an active plan and no PracticePay late fee on any plan fewer than 12 whole months before | 0.05 |
| none such; an active plan but a PracticePay late fee in that time | none |
| only cancelled or charged-off plans, or none | none |

## Case (hypothetical, request on 1 October)

An active plan whose only PracticePay late fee was charged on 1 October of the year before: 12 whole months back, not counted: 0.05.
